blogs.title: Modern Computer Antivirus
blogs.content:
At present every computer user is facing problem of his system being affected by the malware programs.
Malware is term which collectively refers to malicious programs like virus, Trojans, worms and spyware
programs. Once your computer has been affected an unauthorized person can track your personnel works,
modify the contents of your personnel document and use your computer to attack other computers. Antivirus
softwares are the programs which help in building a shield which protects your computer system from being
affected by the malware programs.
The antivirus programs detect and blocks the malware programs that tries to infect the system. Modern
antivirus works by comparing files to a known set of virus signatures and behaviour of the programs. These
